onboarding: Which sites do you get stuck on most? Pick them — I'll be there 🫂

settings.intro: Choose the places where you'd like a gentle pause.
settings.sitesDescription: You can change these whenever you like.
settings.youtubeWarning: YouTube is also used for studying, so it isn’t included by default. Add it only if it’s one of your personal traps.
settings.permissionGranted: Access granted. Focus Friend will show a pause the next time you visit a selected site.
settings.permissionDenied: Without access, Focus Friend can’t pause on those sites. You can try again later.
settings.permissionRequestError: Chrome couldn't request access. Reload the extension and try again.
settings.noEnabledSites: Turn on at least one site first.
settings.siteAddedAccessNeeded: Site added. Allow access to selected sites to show pauses there.
settings.invalidDomain: Enter a website address, like reddit.com.
settings.duplicateDomain: That site is already on your list.
settings.cooldownDescription: After you continue, Focus Friend will leave that site alone for this long.
settings.checkinLabel: Ask once after repeated “Not now” choices
settings.checkinDescription: When enabled, after you choose “Not now” more than 5 times for one site in a day, I’ll ask once whether you want to keep its pause.
settings.footerNote: Your choices are saved in Chrome. No account needed.

same_as_last: Another {n} cycles. Here's a thing about that—

fact_intro: And now, a tiny bit of trivia—
swerve_intro: {n} cycles. Nothing to do with that number, but—

1.text: An octopus has one centralized brain, but two-thirds of its neurons live in its arms. Each arm can basically think for itself.

3.text: A squid has three hearts. Two pump blood to the gills; one pumps it to the rest of the body.

8.text: An octopus has eight arms. Each arm has a network of neurons that helps it carry out many tasks independently.

general_facts.text: A group of crows is called a murder. A group of owls is called a parliament.
There's a species of frog that can freeze solid in winter and thaw back to life in spring.
Scotland's national animal is the unicorn.
A cloud can weigh over a million pounds and still float.
Polar bears have black skin under their white fur.
Some turtles can breathe through their cloaca.
Hot water can freeze faster than cold water under the right conditions. Scientists still debate why.
Humans share about 60% of their DNA with a banana.
The number of possible chess games is greater than the number of atoms in the observable universe.
Crows can remember human faces for years and may warn other crows about them.
Bananas are naturally slightly radioactive because of their potassium.
Sea otters may hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift apart in the current.
A group of flamingos is sometimes called a flamboyance.
Wombats produce cube-shaped droppings, which are less likely to roll away when used to mark territory.
Cats usually have fewer toes on their back paws than their front paws—four in back, five in front.
A lightning channel can be much hotter than the surface of the sun, but only for a very brief moment.
A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
Sloths can hold their breath longer than dolphins by slowing their heart rate.
Butterflies can taste with their feet.
The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896 lasted less than an hour.
A shrimp's heart is located in its cephalothorax, the front body region often called its head.
A thorough hand-wash takes about 20 seconds—roughly two rounds of 'Happy Birthday.'
